description: This file defines extension methods for accessing stream providers in Orleans grains and clients. It provides utility functions that retrieve stream providers by name, handling null or whitespace names, and throwing exceptions if providers are not found.

classes.name: GrainStreamingExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for accessing stream providers from Grain or IGrainBase instances.

classes.name: ClientStreamingExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for accessing stream providers from IClusterClient instances.

methods.name: GetStreamProvider (Grain extension)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream provider by name from a Grain instance.

methods.name: GetStreamProvider (IGrainBase extension)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream provider by name from an IGrainBase instance, throws if not found.

methods.name: GetStreamProvider (IClusterClient extension)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream provider by name from an IClusterClient instance.
